console.notAdmin: Your account is not an administrator of this workspace.
perm.explain: Grants apply per table, for one role at a time. A table with no grant is not readable, is not retrieved, and cannot appear in generated SQL.
perm.none: No tables in the catalog yet. Sync a connection first.
perm.confirmWrite:
Allow this role to change data in {table}?

It covers adding, updating and deleting rows. Every change still needs someone to approve the exact statement before it runs.
perm.defaultDeny: Default deny. A table needs an explicit read grant to be retrieved at all, and an explicit write grant before any change to it can even be proposed.
perm.columnsNeedWrite: Set this table to Read & write to choose which columns may be changed.
perm.columnsExplain: Which columns this role may assign. Unticking one leaves it readable but unchangeable.
perm.generated: The database computes this column, so it can never be assigned.
rules.platformHelp: Applies to every workspace in this deployment. These cannot be edited or deleted here; some may be switched off.
rules.fromLibraryHelp: Copied from a starter pack. They belong to this workspace now, so edit or delete them freely.
rules.writtenHelp: Rules this workspace wrote. They apply to everyone who uses it.
rules.priorityHelp: Higher comes first, and survives longest if the prompt has to be trimmed. Platform rules sit above 900.
lib.removedKept: Removed {n} rules; kept {kept} you had edited
lib.confirmRemove: Remove this pack? Rules you have edited are kept.
perm.defaultsHelp: What {role} is granted before anybody edits the matrix. Applying writes real grants, which you can then change table by table.
perm.enforceReads: Also decide what may be read
perm.enforceReadsHelp: Off by default. Grants have governed writes only, so switching this on with an empty matrix would hide every table from this role.
perm.confirmApply: Apply this preset to {role} now? This writes grants and re-checks any write already approved.
perm.can_readHelp: Appears in the schema shown to the model, and may be selected.
perm.can_filterHelp: May be used in WHERE, HAVING, JOIN and ORDER BY.
perm.can_aggregateHelp: May be counted, summed, grouped or partitioned by.
perm.can_writeHelp: May be assigned by an approved write.
perm.columnsNeedRead: Grant the table read access first, then choose columns.
perm.writeNeedsTable: The table is read-only, so no column can be written.
ws.addDatabaseHelp: The connection is tested before it is stored. Permissions are set per database on the Permissions tab.
ws.label: Label
ws.needsOneDatabase: A workspace needs at least one database.
ws.confirmRemoveDatabase: Stop offering {name}? Permissions written against it are kept.
dom.title: Business domains
dom.banner: A domain describes what a slice of this database is for: the tables that belong together and the words people use about them. The model reads all of it. It is not an access control — grants decide what may be read, and adding a table here grants nothing.
dom.empty: No domains yet. One per subject area — Sales, Support, Inventory — is the usual shape.
dom.name: Name
dom.descriptionPlaceholder: Orders, invoices and the customers they belong to.
dom.tablesHelp: Checked tables are the ones this domain covers. Membership steers which tables the model is shown for a question; it does not grant access to them.
dom.noCatalog: This workspace has no scanned catalog yet, so there are no tables to choose.
dom.termsHelp: The terms of art a schema cannot carry — "churn: no order in 90 days". Each one reaches the model verbatim.
dom.deleteBody: {name} will no longer steer retrieval. Descriptions written for its tables are kept.
ov.healthPlatformOnly: Connection health is shown to platform administrators.
ov.allHealthy: Every registered database answered its last check.
ov.noSources: No databases are registered for this workspace.
audit.accessScope: The access log is per workspace. Showing {workspace}.
